title: Long-rest marks are lost when workouts come back from the cloud copy
what: The account cloud copy of a workout leaves out the rest taken before each set and the rest planned. A workout brought back on a new phone, or written back from the server copy, loses its long-rest marks, so a set done after a long rest raises the next Target again.
expected: The cloud copy carries the rest taken and the rest planned for each set, as the Drive backup does.
who: members who use the cloud copy on a second or new phone
how_often: every workout brought back from the cloud copy
fix_line: Add the two rest values to the packed workout sets and to the insert
